name: Trade Transaction Identification 17
definition: Provides details on transaction and conducting counterparty.

TechnicalRecordIdentification.name: Technical Record Identification
TechnicalRecordIdentification.definition: Unique identifier of a record in a message used as part of error management and status advice message.

ReportingCounterparty.name: Reporting Counterparty
ReportingCounterparty.definition: Unique code identifying the reporting counterparty.

ReportSubmittingEntity.name: Report Submitting Entity
ReportSubmittingEntity.definition: Unique code identifying the entity which submits the report. In the case where submission of the report has been delegated to a third party or to the other counterparty, a unique code identifying that entity.

EntityResponsibleForReport.name: Entity Responsible For Report
EntityResponsibleForReport.definition: Unique code identifying that the Financial counterparty responsible for reporting on behalf of the other counterparty.
